legacy40.role: separate historical benchmark; excluded from new sampling

canonicalization: Map recognized literal tokens to broad features, deduplicate/sort, retain source convention. Do not infer PURE. PURE/RICH co-occurrence rejected. Literal classification, literal feature pieces and subtype codes retained.

deduplication.normalization: casefold -> Unicode NFD -> remove combining marks -> replace nonword/nonwhitespace with spaces -> collapse whitespace; sort two normalized lines for unordered key
deduplication.near_match: Either alignment has both normalized line SequenceMatcher(autojunk=False).ratio >=0.92; exact normalized lines match directly
deduplication.selection: Normalize/deduplicate corpus in source order; exclude conflicting literal-label keys. For M,F2,F3, shuffle remaining class candidates with one Random(seed), greedily accept120 passing exclusions, first100 main/next20 examples; shuffle main then examples with same RNG.
deduplication.scope_limit: Text-pair near duplication only; different verses with the same rhyme endings may remain. No reliable poem identifiers, so poem-level disjointness cannot be established.

manifest_schema.input_file: relative path to split input JSON array

reference_schema.literal_features: literal hyphen pieces (legacy supplied list preserved)
reference_schema.provenance: source group, original zero-based row index and available metadata; no invented poem IDs

limitations: Reference labels are automatic and may be wrong.
Author codes retained literally; no author-name decoding inferred.
Some source grouping uses top-level poet field; no poem-level grouping available.
Legacy grouping recovered only through unambiguous normalized-pair match to source metadata; otherwise missing.
Legacy text line breaks are restored only from unique literal space-slash-space separator.
